title: Resilience of Singapore's Economy and Supply Chain
what_it_is: Resilience of Singapore's Economy and Supply Chain

sections.label: COVID-19 impact on Singapore economy
sections.summary: The COVID-19 outbreak has adversely affected Singapore's economy.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: The COVID-19 outbreak has adversely affected Singapore's economy.

sections.label: Domestic export concentration in 2019
sections.summary: No single economy accounted for more than 15% of Singapore's domestic exports in 2019.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: No single economy accounted for more than 15% of our domestic exports in 2019.

sections.label: Stockpiles and supply chain resilience
sections.summary: Singapore stockpiles rice, personal protective equipment and pharmaceuticals, has local manufacturing for noodles and masks, and MTI works to diversify supply sources and build local production.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: For instance, we stockpile rice, personal protective equipment and pharmaceuticals during peacetime, and we also have local manufacturing capabilities for other items such as noodles and masks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: MTI will continue to work with our businesses to improve the resilience of our supply chains by buying our inputs and essential supplies from different countries, and building up local production capacity where possible and where it makes economic sense.

sections.label: Confidence in essential item supply
sections.summary: Despite panic buying in some places, Singapore is confident its stockpile of essential items and diversified supply sources will suffice.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: In certain places, they do have panic buying that have resulted in some of the situations that the Member has described.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: But we are confident that if we look at our overall situation – a combination of stockpile of essential items plus diversified supply sources – I think we will be okay.

sections.label: Mask advice for unwell people
sections.summary: Governments and health authorities, including WHO, the US, the UK and France, advised wearing masks only if unwell.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: Like other countries, WHO, the US, the UK and recently, France as well, the governments and health authorities have advised the population that you only need to wear masks if you are unwell.

sections.label: Chinese tourists to Singapore
sections.summary: For Singapore, 20% of tourists come from China.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: For Singapore, 20% of our tourists come from China.

sections.label: 30-30 vision ambition
sections.summary: The speaker states that 30-30 is already a very ambitious vision.

sentences.speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
sentences.text: As he correctly pointed out, 30-30 is already a very ambitious vision.
